purpose: Build ShredBoost 1.0: an aggressive pre-amp attack shaper, overdrive, and low-end tightener engineered for high-gain thrash rhythm and fast lead guitar, as a complete professional C++20 JUCE plugin. Product identity (binding, used consistently in CMake, plugin metadata, and state): project/plugin name ShredBoost, vendor nSpace Systems, version 1.0.0, manufacturer code NSPC, plugin code ShBs, bundle identifier com.nspacesystems.shredboost, LV2 URI urn:nspacesystems:plugin:shredboost. Target formats: Linux VST3, Linux LV2, Linux Standalone; a windows-msvc CMake preset is generated as configuration for later Windows tooling. JUCE is a git submodule at ./JUCE pinned to commit 7c9d3783b127263d72bb65fe0a7e2dc8a02a7ac2; no task modifies anything under JUCE/. Binding engineering rules restated into materialized tasks: (1) Real-time constraints: inside processBlock zero heap allocation, locks, file IO, string construction, GUI calls, or buffer resizing; all buffers allocated during prepareToPlay; juce::ScopedNoDenormals instantiated at top of processBlock. (2) Domain smoothing: linear SmoothedValue for dB values (input_trim, mid_amount, drive, level, pick_attack); multiplicative SmoothedValue for strictly positive frequencies (tight_cut, mid_freq, tone); 15 ms equal-power crossfade for discrete topology switches (voicing_mode). (3) DSP processing chain order: [0] Input Trim -> [1] Pre-Drive Tight HPF (RBJ 2nd-order, Q=0.707 or Q=1.2 Precision Tight) -> [2] Pre-Clip Mid Voicing Bell (RBJ 2nd-order) -> [3] Level-Independent Transient Pick-Attack Shaper -> [4] Oversampling Upsample (1x/2x/4x polyphase FIR) -> [5] Nonlinear Clip (Yng-Grey, Precision Tight, SD-1, Clean) -> [6] Downsample + Anti-Aliasing LPF -> [7] DC Blocker (1st-order HPF, R=0.9975) -> [8] Post-Drive Tone LPF -> [9] Output Level + Gain-Matched Bypass RMS Tracker. (4) Oversampling changes happen on the message thread with re-prepare and a 10 ms mute-fade, reporting PDC latency via setLatencySamples. (5) Testing uses the juce::UnitTest console runner target executed via CTest; no third-party testing frameworks allowed. (6) Explicit cmake/ctest verification commands are required per task as no C++ language adapter exists in the registry.
async_strategy: Phases run sequentially a through h. Within each phase, Wave 1 tasks create disjoint new module files and run in parallel; later waves handle integration and shared fan-in files (CMakeLists.txt, PluginProcessor.*, PluginEditor.*, ParameterLayout.*), each owned by exactly one task per wave with same-phase writes serialized via dependencies. The final wave of each phase executes phase verification or CTest runner tasks.
cost_estimate: 34 tasks balanced evenly across 3 execution backends: 11 hardest tasks on codex_cli (account default), 11 middle tasks on antigravity_cli (account default), and 12 easiest tasks on pi_cli via OpenRouter GLM 5.21.

phases.goal: Establish the buildable ShredBoost plugin scaffold with exact product identity and Linux target formats. PluginProcessor.h/.cpp shell enforces bus layout (mono-in/mono-out, mono-in/stereo-out, stereo-in/stereo-out) with deterministic unused output channel clearing and juce::ScopedNoDenormals. PluginEditor.h/.cpp minimal editor shell. CMakeLists.txt configures juce_add_plugin with PRODUCT_NAME ShredBoost, COMPANY_NAME 'nSpace Systems', VERSION 1.0.0, PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE NSPC, PLUGIN_CODE ShBs, BUNDLE_ID com.nspacesystems.shredspace, LV2URI urn:nspacesystems:plugin:shredboost, FORMATS VST3 LV2 Standalone, CXX_STANDARD 20. CMakePresets.json provides linux-release and windows-msvc presets. scripts/build_all.sh paste-and-run build script. Phase verification document docs/verification/phase_a_scaffold.md.

phases.goal: Implement pre-drive filtering and calibration stages. Source/DSP/InputTrimStage.h/.cpp: smoothed gain Gin = 10^(trim/20) with peak/RMS signal level metering. Source/DSP/TightFilter.h/.cpp: 2nd-order RBJ HPF with tight_cut frequency (80-400 Hz); Q=0.707 standard Butterworth, Q=1.2 resonant bump (+1.8 dB overshoot at cutoff) in Precision Tight mode. Source/DSP/MidVoicingFilter.h/.cpp: 2nd-order RBJ peaking bell filter centered at mid_freq (500-1200 Hz), boosting up to +9 dB before non-linear stage with Q_m=0.9. tests/FilterTests.cpp verifies frequency response, Q-factor resonance bump, mid-bell peaking curve, and input trim attenuation.

phases.goal: Implement transient shaping, clipping, DC blocking, and tone filtering. Source/DSP/TransientShaper.h/.cpp: level-independent envelope follower ratio delta_rel = clamp((e_fast - e_slow)/(e_slow + epsilon), 0, 2.0) with tau_fast=1ms, tau_slow=15ms. Source/DSP/NonlinearClipper.h/.cpp: 4 voicing modes: (0) Yng-Grey (arctan + gamma*v^2*exp(-|v|), gamma=0.15), (1) Precision Tight (symmetric tanh), (2) Asymmetric SD-1 (piecewise tanh, k_pos=1.0, k_neg=1.8), (3) Clean Attack Boost (clipping bypassed); 15 ms equal-power crossfade during voicing_mode switching. Source/DSP/DcBlocker.h/.cpp: 1st-order high-pass y_dc(n) = x(n) - x(n-1) + R*y_dc(n-1) with R=0.9975. Source/DSP/ToneFilter.h/.cpp: 2nd-order RBJ LPF (1-16 kHz). Source/DSP/ShredBoostEngine.h/.cpp composes all stages in binding sequence. tests/WaveshaperTests.cpp asserts output mean ≈ 0 under asymmetric drive and click-free crossfade bounds.
phases.async_notes: Wave 1: d.1 (TransientShaper), d.2 (NonlinearClipper), and d.3 (DcBlocker & ToneFilter) run in parallel. Wave 2: d.4 (ShredBoostEngine) composes all stages (depends on d.1, d.2, d.3). Final wave: d.5 creates tests/WaveshaperTests.cpp and updates CMakeLists.txt (depends on d.4).
phases.risk_notes: DC blocker is mandatory following asymmetric waveshapers. Topology crossfade must avoid step discontinuities.

phases.goal: Implement oversampling and auto gain-matched bypass. Source/DSP/OversamplingEngine.h/.cpp: polyphase FIR half-band engine wrapping juce::dsp::Oversampling<float> for 1x, 2x, 4x rates; reports PDC latency via setLatencySamples; oversampling factor changes handled on message thread with re-prepare and 10 ms mute-fade. Source/DSP/AutoGainBypass.h/.cpp: RMS tracking circuit comparing dry input vs wet output to calculate dynamic level difference, applying dry compensation gain during bypass preview. tests/OversamplingTests.cpp asserts inharmonic aliasing floor rejection and exact PDC latency reporting.
